lines.msg: Unauthorized admin session detected from RCECD-POS09 (10.12.200.102)
User: jdoe (stolen credentials). Session type: SQL injection via unauthenticated admin interface on CAD-APP01.
Script executed: cleaner.bat (SHA256: a7e3f1d9c2b8e6a4f0c7d5e1b3a2c9f4e6d8b7c1a2f5e4d3c6b9a8f7e1d2c3b4)
Unit status modified for 17 active calls (include: 26-104455, 26-104456, 26-104457). Status altered to 'Available' despite active dispatch.
ALI geolocation data altered for 12 incidents. Source: CAD-MDS01. Verification required.
Session duration: 32 seconds. No authentication logs recorded.
Source: Unauthenticated admin interface on CAD-APP01 (10.72.30.10).
Log entry confirmed on REC-01 (RCECD-F-21). Evidence preserved.
Session terminated by watchdog process on CAD-MDS01.
Audit trail closed. No further access attempted.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the attacker’s actions and data tampering. The Technical Lead must now declare CAD data untrustworthy and initiate the manual dispatch protocol per RCECD-OPS-2026 Section 7.
